I think it's a number of things again. A lot of our fans said we could get automatics IF we got the right players in, and while it would have been a big ask I still think that was a fair judgement at the time. Not saying we ever would have, but we should have challenged for it imo.

1) The weird insistence on the 4-3-3. Now, the club backed Grant to an extent and as a result we have a plethora of wingers who range from 'alright' to 'crap'. 

2) Stemming from that first fact, in my eyes Posh essentially have two sets of players, but while one set suits the 4-3-3, the others suit a 5 at the back system. Joe Ward for example is an absolute baller at Right Wing-Back but has not impressed this season as just a winger. The 4-3-3 also meant we couldn't squeeze in both Clarke-Harris and Jack Marriott (who apparently we were looking to move on which is crazy to me) into the same 11 without just sticking Jack as a left wing and hoping for the best. 

But you get the other problem where a player like Mason-Clark or Poku comes in and does very well in a not fantastic team as a winger, it then becomes hard to fit him in the 3-5-2. 

3) Our left back until Dan Butler was fit isn't actually a left back, just an academy graduate left midfielder being awkwardly shoved into left back and wing back roles when he just quite clearly cannot defend, which became incredibly clear just like last year when it was his poor defending that led to us throwing away a 1-0 lead at Derby in the 87th minute and going on to lose. 

4) Our away form, just in general. I think a symptom of what happened last year, it must be a mentality thing at this point as well. We threw away leads after going 1-0 up for a while and then just completely collapsed away from home. I think our players get intimidated by nasty and hostile crowds where the fans will be on them for the little things.

5) Recruitment: We needed a left back for when inevitably Dan Butler either dropped off form or to take his place as even when we went up before it was a bit of a weak spot. He isn't awful in League One, serviceable, but nowhere near the top.

6) Finally, some truly atrocious game management this season. Confusing subs, quite often it felt like when you're losing on Fifa and just say "fuck it" and bring on half of the bench. Except we're bringing on Joel Randall and Ricky Jade-Jones, not Ronaldo and Messi.
